# Social Anxiety Institute

> Comprehensive CBT-based treatment programs and educational resources for social anxiety disorder led by Dr. Thomas A. Richards.

The Social Anxiety Institute provides evidence-based cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) treatment through multiple delivery formats including online self-help programs, local Phoenix group therapy via Zoom, and intensive international group programs. The institute serves as both a clinical practice and educational resource center for individuals seeking to understand and overcome social anxiety disorder.

- Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT)

## Core Programs & Treatment

- [Social Anxiety Institute](https://socialanxietyinstitute.org): Homepage for Social Anxiety Institute with CBT treatment programs by Dr. Richards
- [Overcoming Social Anxiety | Anxiety Network](https://socialanxietyinstitute.org/social-anxiety-treatment/online-therapy/overcoming-social-anxiety): Main CBT self-help program: Overcoming Social Anxiety Step by Step
- [Social Anxiety Disorder Treatments | Social Anxiety Institute](https://socialanxietyinstitute.org/social-anxiety-treatment): Overview of treatment programs: weekly groups, intensive groups, audio therapy series
- [Local Phoenix Group Description | Social Anxiety Institute](https://socialanxietyinstitute.org/social-anxiety-treatment/local-phoenix-group/description): Description of local Phoenix CBT group therapy program via Zoom
- [International Group: Description | Social Anxiety Institute](https://socialanxietyinstitute.org/social-anxiety-treatment/international-group/description): Intensive 3-week international CBT group program by Dr. Thomas A. Richards

## Understanding Social Anxiety

- [What is Social Anxiety? | The Social Anxiety Institute](https://socialanxietyinstitute.org/what-is-social-anxiety): Educational overview of social anxiety disorder, symptoms, and prevalence
- [What is it like to live with Social Anxiety? | Social Anxiety Institute](https://socialanxietyinstitute.org/node/14): Patient perspectives on daily challenges of living with social anxiety disorder
- [A Personal Note to People with Social Anxiety | Social Anxiety Institute](https://socialanxietyinstitute.org/personal-note-people-social-anxiety): Dr. Richards' personal message on CBT treatment and recovery from social anxiety
- [Complex Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder | Social Anxiety Institute](https://socialanxietyinstitute.org/complex-PTSD): Educational resource on Complex PTSD and its relationship to social anxiety

## About the Institute & Leadership

- [Welcome from Dr. Thomas A. Richards | Social Anxiety Institute](https://socialanxietyinstitute.org/welcome-dr-thomas-richards): Welcome message from Dr. Richards, founder and director of the Institute
